item.title: SME Digitalization: Which Business Processes to Tackle First
item.summary: A small e-commerce store sells health and wellness items. Despite a small team size of 35 employees, the company prides itself on being fully digital. Its customers place orders, make payments, and receive automated shipping notifications directly from the store’s site. They also have access to support and can solve disputes online.
